meta.label: Ogre Ravager
sources: lore/core/lore_master.md (Ogre: Ravager - grapples, shock, frenzy control; cannibal-heal risks)
invented: stat_modifiers are the old STR +4 / TOU +3 / DEX -2 scaled x3 (legacy rule): no new numbers
abilities renamed to the d100 class layout; descriptions and numbers unchanged
changes: 2026-11-03: flesh_rend and gluttons_vitality no longer heal or add corruption from flesh; lore says tear, not devour (owner t105)

Ogre_Ravager.description: Brutal melee destroyer driven by hunger, tearing foes apart in grimdark frenzy.
Ogre_Ravager.lore: Ravagers tear through Cursed Swamps, their frenzy drawing Dark Elves as handlers.

flesh_rend.description: Enhanced grab_rip: tears and rips flesh from a grabbed foe (extra bleeding). No healing, no corruption: only the Ogre Flesh Eater eats foes (rules/ogre_hunger.json devour).

devour_charge.description: Throw + bonus attack, with self-stun risk (5% chance).

gluttons_vitality.description: Recover stamina after rip/smash, +bleeding to grabbed. No healing or corruption from flesh (only the Flesh Eater eats foes).
